about.title: Our Story
about.heroDesc: A family adventure born from the passion for craftsmanship and the taste of good things.
about.journeyP1: In 2014, in the heart of Ksar Sghir, Al Manara opened the doors of its bakery and pastry shop. Raised in artisan families, they grew up surrounded by the smell of fresh bread and the crackling of the oven.
about.journeyP2: After years of training with the best, they united their talents to create a place where tradition and creativity meet.
about.journeyP3: Today, Al Manara has become an essential destination for food lovers. Our team carries on this heritage every day, with the same attention to detail and the same quality standards.
about.val1Desc: Local mill flour, AOP butter, Valrhona chocolate, seasonal fruits.
about.val2Desc: Everything prepared on-site, every day, with no frozen products.
about.val3Desc: A united team sharing the same passion for craftsmanship.
about.val4Desc: Recyclable packaging, anti-waste, short supply chain.
